messages:
Aria: Quick brain dump from today's sync 14 proposing a small pilot to split the monolithic inference-orchestrator into two bounded services: routing (stateless) + session-store (stateful). Need feedback on ownership, migration steps, and rollback safety.
Jon: +1 on splitting. main risk = session migration & tenant skew. what's pilot scope?
Aria: Pilot scope: (1) route-only for read-mostly tenants, (2) mirror-write sessions for a subset, (3) measure latency/cost. No full cutover in pilot.
Priya: Mirror-write is good. Do we have a divergence check tool?
Theo: We can reuse diff-runner (from config-store). infra-bot: diff-runner v2 deployed to staging, docs: https://infra.redwood/internal/diff-runner.
Jon: Ownership: who runs session-store? platform or inference team?
Aria: Proposal: session-store ops-owned for runtime/backups; routing stays inference-owned. A rotating "contract guardian" owns API contract and tests.
Priya: Rotation + 3-way on-call overlap for first 2 weeks sounds right.
Theo: Suggest "migration fence" adapter: shim that implements existing API and forwards to new store when header flag enabled. Allows per-tenant flips.
Aria: Canary plan: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% by tenant cohorts if error < 0.5% and p95 delta < 20ms. Prefer automated ramps if possible.
Jon: Router automation would be great. infra-bot: router supports weighted rules (policy v3). Example: policy with tenant match and weight.
Priya: Need a migration-events stream (Kafka) for audit/rollback decisions; stdout logs are messy.
Theo: Also cap adapter memory. Last pilot hit 60MB peak. infra-bot: adapter-sidecar mem 55-70MB (95th).
Aria: If mem is an issue, we can inline a tiny shim in binary as fallback. Keep adapters minimal.
Jon: Preflight debt concerns: what must be fixed before ramp?
Priya: Preflight checklist: (a) callers + dependency graph, (b) top 5 risky flows by errors, (c) migration test harness + diff-runner config, (d) rollback plan + owners, (e) perf baseline. Also block ramp past 10% if any severity >=3 debt items are unfixed.
Aria: Agreed. Owners must be able to deploy, oncall, and resolve P1s. If not, designate co-owner or rotate with platform.
Jon: Metrics to track: p50/p95 latency, error-rate delta, cost tokens/sec, divergence rate, time-to-rollback.
Priya: Add compatibility metric: % responses passing contract assertions. Pilot target = 99.9%.
Theo: Keep API surface minimal: CreateSession, FetchSession, SnapshotSession. Everything else via adapters.
Aria: I'll draft RFC with goal, scope, preflight checklist, canary knobs, ownership matrix, migration playbook. Seeking reviewers by Wed.
infra-bot: Epic created: SERVICE-DECOMP-397654 (https://boards.redwood/internal/epics/397654).
Jon: Action items: Aria -> RFC draft by Wed; Priya -> diff-runner config; Theo -> adapter resource budget; infra-bot -> attach perf links to epic.
Aria: Thanks all. Closing thread.
